title: Granular canary + shadow matrix for embedding model onboarding and retrofit
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: build a reproducible, tenant-aware onboarding flow for new embedding models and quantized variants that supports (1) parallel shadow evaluation, (2) granular canaries by tenant cohort, (3) automated semantic-drift gates, and (4) safe deprecation paths. This ticket covers the runtime routing matrix, telemetry contract, backfill plan for reranker/semantic-index compatibility, and an operator-friendly rollout UI hook for Console.

acceptance_criteria: 1) New model can be onboarded in staging via a single API flag that creates: alias (vN), shadow route, canary cohort config, and telemetry hooks.
2) Shadow evaluations run at configurable sample rates without impacting production latency budgets (target <5% median latency regression across p95 tenants).
3) Per-tenant canary weight adjustments possible via API/Console; default cohort bucketing uses QPS + avg query length rules.
4) Automated quality fences evaluate semantic similarity distributions and reranker NDCG deltas; alerts created when thresholds breached.
5) Backfill plan for reranked indices documented with safe-swapping steps and a rollback path (no-downtime alias swap tested).
6) End-to-end test coverage and a staging runbook exist with observed metrics in the dashboard links.
7) Dependencies with ENG-110237 gated and documented; no production flips until dependency signals green.
technical_notes: Routing: introduce a 2-stage routing matrix — (A) alias resolution to model family + variant, (B) cohort policy layer supporting shadow/canary/steady states.
KV cache compatibility: quantized variants must share deterministic KV keying to allow warm prefixes; added a compatibility shim for legacy models.
Telemetry contract: request-level tags: model_alias, model_variant, tenant_cohort, sample_rate, shadow=true/false. Aggregations emitted to metrics pipeline and semantic-regression job.
Quality fences: two-tier checks: distributional (KS test on cosine similarity for sampled queries) + task-specific (NDCG for reranker pairs). Thresholds configurable per-release.
Scaling: canary cohorts limited to 5% of production QPS by default; autoscaler SLOs updated to consider shadow CPU overhead; recommend separate CPU pool reservation for heavy shadow sampling.
Data privacy: shadow traffic must obey tenant data policy; option to scrub PII in shadowing path for customers who opt out.
rollout_plan: Stage 0 - Design & gating: finalize telemetry schema and cohort bucketing rules. (Done)
Stage 1 - Staging shadow: enable 5% sampled shadow for new model; run 2 weeks of shadow-evals across 3 tenant cohorts.
Stage 2 - Canary cohorts: select conservative tenants (low p95 latency, representative query lengths) and open canary at 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 48 hours with automated quality checks.
Stage 3 - Gradual ramp: if gates pass, increase to 25% then 50% with daily regression monitoring; hold for 72 hours at each step.
Stage 4 - Full swap: alias swap to new variant with blue/green fallback alias; keep shadowing legacy model for 7 days and schedule deprecation window.
Stage 5 - Deprecation: after 14 days of stable metrics, deprecate legacy variant and trigger catalog cleanup via ENG-110237.
telemetry_requirements: Emit model_alias and model_variant as tags on every inference metric.
Shadow tests must emit paired similarity scores and sample ids to the semantic-regression job for drift analysis.
Reranker backfill job to report NDCG@10, precision@k and coverage delta per tenant per variant.
SLOs: median latency regression <3%, 95th percentile latency regression <7% for affected cohorts.
